name: Boost Grow QA Evaluator - Auto Read

parameters.formDescription: No JSON required. First process one batch of synthetic QA documents through the Finance Agent. Then submit this form to read Income, Expenses, Review Log, Drive processing folders, reviewer emails and the read-only Ground Truth. The evaluator does not process or move files; it only updates the QA Manifest and Test Log. Run Batch 1 first so the canonical invoice exists before duplicate tests. Do not use live customer invoices.

values.fieldLabel: Manual handling time per document in minutes (optional)
Human effort per document after automation in minutes (optional)

parameters.jsCode: const r=$("Compare Results Against Ground Truth").all().map(x=>x.json),count=s=>r.filter(x=>x.pass_fail===s).length,t=r.filter(x=>typeof x.manual_minutes==="number"&&typeof x.human_minutes_after_automation==="number"),manual=t.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.manual_minutes,0),human=t.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.human_minutes_after_automation,0),saved=manual-human;return[{json:{run_id:r[0]?.run_id||"",total_cases:r.length,passed:count("PASS"),failed:count("FAIL"),incomplete:count("INCOMPLETE"),completion_rate_pct:r.length?Math.round(count("PASS")/r.length*10000)/100:0,time_study_cases:t.length,measured_manual_minutes:Math.round(manual*100)/100,measured_human_minutes_after_automation:Math.round(human*100)/100,measured_human_minutes_saved:t.length?Math.round(saved*100)/100:null,measured_time_reduction_pct:t.length&&manual>0?Math.round(saved/manual*10000)/100:null,results:r.map(x=>({case_id:x.case_id,filename:x.filename,pass_fail:x.pass_fail,actual_route:x.actual_route,mismatches:x.mismatches}))}}];

nodeGroups.name: Collect Actual Evidence
nodeGroups.description: Reads finance records, file locations and human-review email evidence.

nodeGroups.name: Compare and Report
nodeGroups.description: Compares observed outcomes, updates QA results and produces a batch summary.
